lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Cesar Nair is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Cesar Nair is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Cesar kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Cesar's gone." Jamie looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Cesar." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Catalina blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Patient Aim (Level 1). One shot. You don't take the shot unless it's the shot.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Weather (Level 1). Red sky at night, shepherd's delight. Red sky at morning, shepherd's warning. It works.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading the Water (Level 1). You know where fish hold: seams, eddies, shade lines. The water stops being a surface and starts being a map.

d41: The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Cesar's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Cesar Nair, 41 days. The mantle passes to Catalina Reyes.
